name: Dorcas
summary: A disciple at Joppa, also called Tabitha, who was known for her good works and her gifts to the poor. When she died, Peter prayed and called her to rise, and she came back to life.

key_moments.title: Mourned by the Widows
key_moments.description: Dorcas, a woman full of good works and gifts to the poor, fell sick and died. The disciples sent for Peter, and the weeping widows showed him the coats and clothes she had made.

key_moments.title: Tabitha, Arise
key_moments.description: Peter sent everyone out, knelt and prayed, and told Tabitha to arise, and she opened her eyes and sat up. Word of it spread through all Joppa, and many people put their faith in the Lord.
